description: We are secondary school students who are participating to gain a new experience
summary: In this project, an "Earth Jukebox" was developed. This tool was designed to convert images and videos into audio so that visually impaired individuals who want to learn more about Earth, can access such data more easily. By sonification, we have been able to turn NASA data to sounds that feel pleasant, dynamic and unique, with a variety of techniques. This project is important as it provides a viable solution for the blind to imagine the Earth in their own sense - sound.
details: This project performs sonification on given NASA data of the Earth. It works by analyzing pixels of the data, and determining their color, brightness and how much they change. Then, these data are converted into audio - volume, pitch, tempo. Sonification has been a viable method to allow visually impaired individuals to imagine the Earth and its data. In this project, AI (Gemini and Claude), Python, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS is used. Software includes Visual Studio Code, Sublime Text, Netlify. Each sonification performed has used a different algorithms suited for that set of data, requiring intense brainstorming and evaluation. Multiple trial and errors were done to produce pleasant sounds for the blind to hear. Our team kept the purpose and audience at utmost priority, where accessibility was key. Time was also an important factor as our team had trouble to be able to perform sonification all sets of data.
